messages:
Maya C.: hey folks — quick question about the orientation kickoff tomorrow. My calendar shows it at 9:00 AM PT but the event on my calendar has no Zoom link. Did anyone else see that? :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Maya! The orientation invite was sent from onboarding@redwood.com. If the event has no link, it may be a duplicate invite. Official event: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: `redwood2026`). ICS: https://redwood.app/ical/orientation_kickoff.ics :calendar:
Alex R.: yep, there were two invites — one from the PLG team and one from People Ops. Deleted the PLG one and re-sent the People Ops invite a few mins ago. Can you refresh your calendar or re-accept? :thumbsup:
Maya C.: refreshed — I see the Zoom now, thanks. Quick timezone check: that Zoom link is for 9AM PT, right? I’m in CET so want to make sure I join at the right time.
Jordan L.: 9AM PT = 12PM ET = 17:00 UTC = 18:00 CET. I’ll post a quick conversion table in the thread for other folks.
Sam T.: thanks. also, is the session going to be recorded and where will the recording live?
Onboarding Bot: The orientation will be recorded. Recording will be uploaded to the New Hires folder in Drive and a link will be posted in #new-hires after the session. If you can’t attend live, RSVP "No" and you'll still get the recording.
Linda K.: FYI — if you see duplicate events, it’s usually caused by overlapping calendar shares (team calendar + onboarding calendar). Recommended fix: accept the invite from "People Ops / Onboarding" and decline the other one. Deleting the duplicate event locally sometimes leaves ghost slots; re-sync calendar app if that happens.
Maya C.: done, accepted the People Ops event. thanks everyone! one last tiny thing — the calendar tile shows "Guests can't join" for me, is that normal?
Alex R.: that’s just the event privacy setting. Guests can still join via Zoom link — ignore the tile. If anyone actually gets blocked when clicking the link, ping me and I’ll escalate.
Jordan L.: tagging for visibility @Sam T. in case you want the conversion table pinned before tomorrow.
Sam T.: got it, will pin a short note with local times for APAC folks too (Auckland, Sydney, India). See you all tomorrow :wave:
